candidate_relations.reason: Ehlers–Danlos syndrome is a connective-tissue fragility disorder, not livedo with atrophie blanche and painful malleolar ulcers.
Antiphospholipid syndrome can cause livedo and ulcers, but no phospholipid-antibody results are provided to confirm or exclude it.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: possible APS cause of livedoid ulcers

candidate_relations.reason: Chronic venous insufficiency typically yields medial gaiter ulcers without a reticular livedo and white atrophic scars on the dorsum of the foot.
Thrombophilia is a listed possible driver of livedoid vasculopathy but is not itself the cutaneous diagnosis and is untested here.
Livedoid vasculopathy matches recurrent painful leg ulcers, livedo reticularis, and atrophie blanche on the ankles and foot dorsum.
Hematologic malignancy was listed on the differential, but no blood counts or marrow data are given to judge it.

case_quality_flags: Livedo, atrophie blanche, and painful ulcers support livedoid vasculopathy, but biopsy results and coagulopathy laboratories are not in the record.
